Accounts, branch/feature authority, reports, payment configuration, oversight, and local backup export
Current local implementation reviewed: 19 October 2026 | Rounded box: activity | Diamond: decision / merge | Small label: responsible actor
Columns are alternative work areas. Merge diamonds combine alternatives; they do not wait for every activity to finish. Pending reviews may be revisited later.
Use the selected action's validation rules. For a timeout or uncertain write result, refresh the record before resubmitting. Leaving an activity returns to the menu.
Archive is an administrative account label in the current code; do not describe it as revoking existing tokens or reliably blocking password login.
Reports, staff Activity Log, media review, and lifecycle recovery reporting are separate workspaces. The recovery report does not repair records.
Backup exports download locally; no retained ZIP, automated schedule, in-app restore, or verified disaster-recovery workflow is implied.
